SOCIETIES ACT 1966

UNLAWFUL SOCIETY ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 5(1) of the Societies Act 1966

[Act 335], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Unlawful Society Order 2015.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 16 February 2015.

Declaration of unlawful society

2. The Minister declares the societies named in the Schedule to be unlawful

societies.
